Title: Verify that a GK One customer can scan a merchant's Dynamic QR code and complete a payment successfully

Step Action: From the Home screen, select Scan to Pay and scan the merchant's Dynamic QR code
Step Expected: The payment interface opens, resolved to the scanned merchant

Step Action: Observe the amount field
Step Expected: The amount field starts at $0.00 and is editable

Step Action: Enter a valid payment amount (e.g. $5,000) and an optional note
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Proceed to the Review and Confirm screen
Step Expected: The payment amount, a Fee line item, and the Total are displayed; the merchant (payee) cannot be changed

Step Action: Select the GK One Prepaid card (wallet) as the payment method
Step Expected: Payment method selected

Step Action: Confirm and submit the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: "Payment successful — $5,000.00 JMD — You've made a payment of $5,000.00 JMD from [Payer Name]" is displayed

Title: Verify that a GK One customer can scan a merchant's Static QR code and complete a payment with the pre-filled amount

Step Action: Scan the merchant's Static QR code
Step Expected: The payment interface opens, resolved to the scanned merchant

Step Action: Observe the amount field
Step Expected: The amount is pre-filled with the merchant's fixed amount and is NOT editable

Step Action: Proceed to the Review and Confirm screen
Step Expected: The pre-filled amount, Fee, and Total are displayed

Step Action: Select a payment method and confirm payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: Payment success is displayed with the correct fixed amount

Title: Verify that a customer can pay using a registered card other than the default GK One Prepaid card after logging into GK One

Step Action: On the Review and Confirm screen, view available payment methods
Step Expected: Both the GK One Prepaid card and the registered "My NCB MasterCard" are shown as selectable options

Step Action: Select "My NCB MasterCard"
Step Expected: Card is selected

Step Action: Confirm and submit the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed using the selected card

Title: Verify that a customer can select and pay with the GK One Prepaid card (wallet), and the wallet balance is debited accordingly

Step Action: Note the GK One Prepaid wallet's current balance
On the Review and Confirm screen, view available payment methods
Step Expected: Both the GK One Prepaid card and the registered "My NCB MasterCard" are shown as selectable options

Step Action: Select the GK One Prepaid card
Step Expected: Card is selected

Step Action: Confirm and submit the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed using the GK One Prepaid wallet balance

Step Action: Check the GK One Prepaid wallet's balance afterward
Step Expected: [UNCERTAIN: confirm whether the Fee line item shown on Review and Confirm is deducted from the wallet along with the payment amount, or billed/handled separately] The balance has decreased by the payment amount (and fee, if applicable)

Title: Verify that a customer can add an optional note to a QR payment and that it is accepted

Step Action: Enter a valid amount and a short note (e.g. "Lunch")
Step Expected: Note is accepted

Step Action: Proceed through review and complete the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed successfully with the note attached

Title: Verify that a customer can complete a QR payment without entering an optional note

Step Action: Enter a valid amount and leave the note field blank
Proceed through review and complete the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed successfully with no note

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the entered amount is below $1000

Step Action: Enter an amount of $999.99
Attempt to proceed
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the entered amount is above $350,000

Step Action: Enter an amount of $350,000.01
Attempt to proceed
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the amount field is left empty on a Dynamic QR payment

Step Action: Leave the amount field empty
Attempt to proceed
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that an invalid or unrecognized QR code fails to resolve before any payment interface is shown

Step Action: Scan the invalid/unrecognized QR code
Step Expected: An error is shown indicating the QR code could not be resolved; no payment interface is opened

Title: Verify that the customer cannot change the payee on a scanned QR payment

Step Action: Look for any control to change or edit the payee/merchant on the payment screen
Step Expected: No such control exists; the payee is fixed to Merchant A throughout the flow

Title: Verify that scanning a Person-to-Person Scan-to-Pay QR code does not allow the transaction to proceed

Step Action: Scan the P2P Scan-to-Pay QR code
Step Expected: Recognized-but-blocked with a specific "not available" message. The transaction does not proceed.

Title: Verify that a payment of exactly $1000 is accepted (lower boundary)

Step Action: Enter an amount of exactly $1,000.00
Attempt to proceed
Step Expected: No validation error is shown; customer can proceed

Title: Verify that a payment of exactly $350,000 is accepted (upper boundary)

Step Action: Enter an amount of exactly $350,000.00
Attempt to proceed
Step Expected: No validation error is shown; customer can proceed

Title: Verify that the Scan to Pay camera requests permission when not already granted, and handles denial gracefully

Step Action: Select Scan to Pay from the Home screen
Step Expected: A camera permission prompt is shown

Step Action: Deny camera permission
Step Expected: The app does not crash; a clear message is shown indicating the camera is required to scan a QR code, and/or a fallback is offered

Title: Verify that Scan to Pay is accessible both from the Home screen and from the GK One Card's "PayMe" button in Wallet

Step Action: From the Home screen, select Scan to Pay
Step Expected: Camera/scan interface opens

Step Action: Navigate to Wallet and select "PayMe" on the GK One Card
Step Expected: Camera/scan interface opens, equivalent to the Home screen entry point

Title: Verify that a receipt is emailed to the customer's registered email address after a successful QR payment

Step Action: Complete a successful QR payment, selecting the registered "My NCB MasterCard" as the payment method
Step Expected: Payment success is confirmed in-app

Step Action: Check the customer's registered email inbox
Step Expected: A receipt email has been received, matching the existing receipt design, immediately after payment

Step Action: Observe the payment method shown on the receipt
Step Expected: The receipt shows the selected payment method as the payment method. Not the GK One Prepaid card or a generic/default label

Title: Verify that a push notification is sent to the customer when a QR payment completes successfully

Step Action: Complete a successful QR payment
Step Expected: Payment success is confirmed in-app

Step Action: Check the device's notification center
Step Expected: A push notification confirming the successful payment has been received

Title: Verify that a push notification is sent to the customer when a QR payment attempt fails

Step Action: Attempt a QR payment that will be declined by the processor
Step Expected: Payment fails; failure is shown in-app

Step Action: Check the device's notification center
Step Expected: A push notification indicating the payment failed has been received
